High-contrast white circular ring coordinates localized at approximately [x=35%, y=50%] and [x=38%, y=54%] on the left lobe, and [x=58%, y=52%], [x=64%, y=48%], and [x=77%, y=51%] on the right lobe.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (scratches) visible on the mid-section of the left lobe's ventral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense clusters of barnacles on both the left and right distal tips. Multiple circular scars scattered across the central ventral surface of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Heavy barnacle encrustation concentrated exclusively on the extreme lateral tips of the fluke.
